cookie.title: Cookies & services
cookie.body: We use necessary technologies to run the website. You choose whether to enable analytics, ad measurement, YouTube videos and our chatbot. You can change your choices at any time in Cookie settings.
cookie.analyticsDescription: Google Analytics helps us analyse page views and how the website is used.
cookie.adsMeasurementDescription: Only with your separate consent, Google Analytics and Google Ads connect successfully submitted enquiries with ads. Requires website analytics. No personalised advertising or remarketing.
cookie.youtubeDescription: Loads embedded videos from YouTube. Technical data may be sent to Google.
cookie.chatbotDescription: Enables our Claude-based Building Advisor. Your chat messages are sent to Anthropic to generate a response.
cookie.saveError: Your choices could not be saved. Please allow website data to be stored in your browser and try again.
